title: 76110 Solo
style: 108 BPM stripped electro-pop, calm male lead with NZ AU lean, single ticking hat, soft kick, single synth pulse, sparse analog bass, glassy synth pad bed, layered backing vocals on chorus, technical-truth doctrine track, restrained build into open final chorus, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — ticking hat, single synth pulse, room tone]
Seven six one one zero… solo
Seven six one one zero… solo
The old line killed — the new line live

[Verse 1]
Two paths running, one had a typo
The other one steady, the other one pro
Killed the seven five one six five clean
Kept the seven six one one zero — lean

No duplicate, no double-write
One source of truth, one signal tight
West Midlands track crossed the line wrong
Disqualified — not where it belongs

[Pre-Chorus]
One path — one truth
One sync — one route
Move don't delete the work that ran
Name the live one, keep the plan

[Chorus]
Seven six one one zero — solo
Seven six one one zero — solo
The line that lived, the line that flowed
Seven six one one zero — solo
CPU steady, signal slow and bold
Seven six one one zero — solo

[Verse 2]
No confusion in the morning logs
No two ghosts running through the fog
One process owns the path
One process holds the math

Clean cut, clean keep
Clean run, clean sleep
The stack stayed alive because we chose
Which line lives — and which one goes

[Pre-Chorus]
One path — one truth
One sync — one route
Move don't delete the work that ran
Name the live one, keep the plan

[Chorus]
Seven six one one zero — solo
Seven six one one zero — solo
The line that lived, the line that flowed
Seven six one one zero — solo
CPU steady, signal slow and bold
Seven six one one zero — solo

[Bridge — stripped, half-spoken]
One line. One truth.
Kill the ghost. Keep the proof.
Signal unblocked. Running clean.
Seven six one one zero — solo.

[Final Chorus]
Seven six one one zero — solo
Seven six one one zero — solo
The line that lived, the line that flowed
Seven six one one zero — solo
CPU steady, signal slow and bold
Seven six one one zero — solo

[Outro]
Seven six one one zero…
Solo… solo…
The stack stayed alive
